::: {#exm-substitution}
#### Replacing a parameter by its argument

With `h` from @exr-formula-from-code, @def-racket-define evaluates `(h 5)` in three steps:

```text
(h 5)
= (- (* 5 5) (* 2 5))
= (- 25 10)
= 15
```

The first step replaces `x` by 5 in the body of `h`,
just as computing $h(5)$ replaces $x$ by 5 in $x^2 - 2x$.

:::
